record.question: Who is the Union Minister of Human Resource Development ministry?
record.explanation: Answer A: Smriti Irani. Smriti Zubin Irani held the Human Resource Development portfolio in the administration relevant to January 2015. The President's February 2015 Vice Chancellors' Conference remarks address her in that exact office and refer to her September 2014 ministerial work. Historical/source note: Historical 2014–2015 office and ministry name, not the current ministry or minister. Reference: https://presidentofindia.nic.in/sites/default/files/sp040215.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
